text: The historical locking patch added using namespace mozilla in MboxMsgInputStream.h. Its later correction removed that import, qualified the member mozilla::Mutex, and imported only mozilla::MutexAutoLock in the implementation file. Recommend this scoped header pattern for related changes so includers do not inherit an unintended namespace import. The linked coding-style page was not read while external access was blocked.
